overview.description: The Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust ETF (MSBT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long btc, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed fund that seeks to track the price performance of spot Bitcoin (BTC). The Trust will hold Bitcoin directly, secured through a multi-layer cold storage wallet MSBT was launched on Apr 7, 2026 and is issued by Morgan Stanley.
